paragraphs: He is mentioned in Gittin, chapter 3, halakhah 1: Rabbi Hananiah reports in his name. Hyman notes an unspecified scribal error there.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman reports an unspecified scribal error in the passage; no correction is supplied or invented here.

The actual Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 3:1 paragraph explicitly has Rabbi Hananyah in the name of Rabbi Bivon bar Chiyyah, supporting the local full titles and direction of reporting. Hyman’s source spellings are retained. His unspecified scribal-error observation remains his report; no correction is invented or Hebrew source changed.
